brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or larger. Opaque PNG.
This is a NEW artwork. The black/lime approved thumbnail shown earlier is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; never copy its player, pose, names, dates, scores or stats. The two official Dererk Pardon portraits shown earlier are LIKENESS REFERENCES ONLY; never paste any photo, logo or lettering from them into the artwork.

Visual style: premium bold Japanese sports editorial graphic, charcoal black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory, a single orange basketball; rough hand-drawn ink hatching, dry brush textures, limited screen-print palette. Clearly illustrated, never photographic or photorealistic. Few large elements. Strong readable typographic hierarchy.
Layout: place one dynamic three-quarter upper-body/upper-thigh player illustration on the RIGHT 43 percent; text fills the LEFT 55 percent with comfortable margins. A sweeping lime brush shape curves behind the figure. All face, scalp, fingers and ball must remain completely inside the frame. Keep at least 50px safe padding for every text line. No hoop, opponent, audience, arena signage or scoreboard.

Person: the real basketball player DERERK PARDON (デレク・パードン), recognizable from the official portraits in this conversation. Adult Black male, tall and very muscular, shaved bald scalp with a high rounded crown, long oval face, closely trimmed sideburns blending into a dense full dark beard extending below the chin, short thin moustache, broad rounded nose, full lips, dark gently arched eyebrows, large alert dark eyes, prominent ears, dark brown skin. Muscular tattooed shoulders and arms; simplify the tattoos into expressive ink shapes without readable tattoo text. Depict his actual facial features in hand-drawn ink, with lively three-quarter view and a focused expression.
Action: dynamic basketball pivot, torso turning toward the left, the orange basketball held firmly with BOTH hands around chest/waist height, elbows naturally bent, shoulders twisting and jersey folds showing movement. Clear anatomically correct two arms and two hands, one thumb and four fingers on each visible hand, no fused or extra fingers, no duplicate ball. This is a generic imagined playing pose, NOT a recreation of a specific match action.
Outfit: plain sleeveless dark charcoal jersey with ivory edge piping and plain dark shorts, no team crest, no league logo, no sponsor, no wordmark, no number, no player name.

TEXT (exactly these strings, carefully rendered in correct Japanese, no additional text):
Small top-left: 「バスケまとめ」
Date beneath brand: 「2026.11.12」
Small simple text label: 「B.PREMIER」
Largest ivory bold headline: 「試合結果」
Next large lime bold line: 「当日のEFF」
Strong ivory/lime secondary line: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Bottom-left clear readable disclosure: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Next to disclosure: 「イメージ」

Factual scope: the article is a same-day game-results and official EFF top-three-by-position roundup. Pardon was selected randomly among named article players because the article has multiple equally weighted comparisons. Do NOT add his name, individual stats, rank, participation, praise, success claims, score, or winning shot. TOP3 describes the article section, not this illustrated player's ranking. Keep position-specific scope on the same visually grouped block as TOP3. No season-average or predictive language. No official photos or logo anywhere. The disclosure イラスト（AI生成） and イメージ must be fully visible and readable, at least 25px high in a 1536px wide output.
Generate the complete final composition and all typography in one image.
